meta.title: Schub — the Miam community's game servers
meta.description: Schub drives the game servers of the Miam Discord community: their live state, starting on demand from the site or Discord, and port forwarding that follows on its own.

hero.title: The Miam community's game servers
hero.subtitle: Servers hosted at home that switch on when you need them.

schub.title: What Schub does
schub.community: Schub is the Miam Discord community's tool: it is made for them, and it gathers their game servers.
schub.servers: Servers are hosted at home and driven from the site or from Discord: their state is visible live, and starting or stopping one is a button. Port forwarding opens and closes along with the server.
schub.identity: Identity goes through Discord. There is no password to remember, and rights follow your role.

premadelab.title: PremadeLab, for League of Legends
premadelab.body: Game analysis has its own site, open to everyone: personal and team statistics, champion pool per role, draft planner, Macro Planner and multiplayer mini-games to kill queue time. Schub only keeps its administration.
